color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Source page background #ffffff qualifies for light register (luminance 255 > 190).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em) applied to all heading sizes (h1–h4). All proprietary fonts (fractul-variable, Hot Rush Script, OverglowFont) replaced with Syne via Google Fonts CDN — geometric editorial sans selected as concept-matched fallback for technical/precise register.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Delay introduction at intensity 3 — 0.1s stagger delay added to all sequential element reveals. New stagger pattern (nth-child CSS vars) applied to card grids, feature lists, and section content entries.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened 10% (intensity 2) — 1440px → 1296px. Section width adjusted proportionally to 1274px. Creates a more editorial reading measure with increased implicit margin on wide screens.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Section-specific breathing room at intensity 3 — section paddingTop/paddingBottom normalized from artifact value (631px) to editorial baseline (120px) then +32px applied = 152px. Other element spacings retained from source system.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist D: Hover opacity at intensity 3 — opacity: 0.75 added to all hover states for links, nav links, buttons, and cards. Unified opacity-fade hover vocabulary across the entire interaction system.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 — 0.08em added to typography.letterSpacing. Font family updated to Syne to align with assembled type-system. Hover style updated to opacity 0.2s ease-in-out.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — spatial system paragraph rewritten to emphasize physical materiality of negative space, section padding, and grid measure as tactile design properties. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with 3 video placements.

consistencyChecks.A_colorContrast: PASS — bodyText #1b1b37 (brightness 30) vs pageBackground #ffffff (brightness 255): high contrast dark-on-light.
consistencyChecks.B_motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover transitions 0.2s, motion stagger 0.1s per item with 0.35s animation duration. Different purposes, no mismatch.
consistencyChecks.C_navFontAvailability: PASS — nav typography fontFamily updated to Syne (present in assembled type-system cssVars).
